class.name: ECSMainLoop
class.brief_description: A [MainLoop] that runs an [ECSWorld] without a SceneTree.

method.name: _input
method.description: Called with every [InputEvent] received by the main window.

method.name: get_canvas_rid
method.description: Returns the canvas attached to the main viewport.

method.name: get_scenario_rid
method.description: Returns the 3D scenario attached to the main viewport.

method.name: get_viewport_rid
method.description: Returns the viewport rendering to the main window.

method.name: quit
method.description: Requests the application to exit at the end of the current iteration.

members.member: The world driven by this main loop. Replacing it hands the viewport, canvas, scenario and physics spaces to the new world.
